reason: Proposal A is more solidly grounded in the known efficacy of aluminide coatings for oxidation protection of refractory alloys and includes a clear, physically sound mechanism and definitive experimental tests. Proposal B relies on indirect evidence from Nb-silicide-based alloys and is less certain to succeed in improving the oxygen resistance of equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr without unforeseen effects on mechanical properties.
